independence_declaration.statement: This qa-verifier session (69564131-…) authored no product implementation in the DG1 scope and no part of the frozen candidate. Before the freeze, an earlier qa-verifier session wrote acceptance TESTS (tests/qa/**, e2e/**: A12/A13/A14/A18/A20), as the protocol allows (test-first; not implementation). This session added new tests only under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-1 record; I have not opened them. All execution ran in a disposable clone under $TMPDIR, never in the candidate tree.

summary: DG1 round-1 QA on frozen candidate sha256:25c97340… (commit 37ec374). Typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI (33 ops), no-CDN, format and contrast all pass. Unit 325/325 on Node 22 and on Node 24. Integration 200/200 in two runs on disposable PG with no 57P01 or hook timeouts. An independent probe confirms migrations 0001-0008 and audit_event append-only for app, owner and superuser. Contract 9/9 incl. getBrandingTokens. Real-stack e2e 18/18 EN+AR (incl. BU-Lead Edit/Archive without reload) with 0 axe violations, and A20 22/22. A20 token propagation passes with a negative control. A18 clean start passes with a real frozen offline install. A12/A13/A14 24/24. A new black-box API probe passes 30/30 and a new worker-stop probe passes. Register, pipeline and reconcile pass; the CI-needs checker rejects QA mutations. Two checks are BLOCKED by the environment, not product defects: the live A24 GitHub Actions run, and install-sandbox AC-1 (effect), which needs the npm registry; existing orchestrator evidence on byte-identical code covers the latter. Findings: F-DG1-230 (Low: 3 DB views undocumented in the data dictionary/ERD) and F-DG1-231 (Low: register rows cite evidence from another candidate and depend on findings not in findings.json). No Critical/High/mandatory findings.
